effective_rule: registered only when this file is merged to main with status 'registered', effective_utc set to the merge time and effective_evidence naming the merge commit; opportunities before that are not prospective evidence; nothing is backfilled as live

instrument.universe: BTC only; no point-in-time universe expansion without a new registration

schedule.basis: measured Oct 12-19 2026 (research_tools/panel.py at cutoff fce9fa2): perp input age at the decision clock median 180 s, p90 300 s at :00 (300-480 s at other offsets), max 900 s

inputs.allowed: research_tools/panel.py panel-1.0.0 features available at the decision time (flow_liquidity, price_response, funding_dispersion, positioning_interaction, spot_perp_basis)
inputs.missing: a required feature missing or older than max_input_age_s: inputs-unavailable, recorded, never filled

horizon_basis: 4h = about 48x the p90 input age; a tens-of-minutes horizon would sit within a few multiples of the measured lag

forecast.representation: p_up: probability that the 240-minute forward log return from the first eligible quote is positive

conversion.sizing: fixed unit; sizing is not tested here

publication.durable: a git commit on main of the forecast record whose content sha256 equals the forecast's, or a registry write with receipt and read-back; the durable copy's own time is the publication time
publication.late: published after the deadline: recorded as publish-late and graded as its own class, never as on-time

execution.entry: open of the first 1m bar starting at or after max(decision, publication) + delay_s
execution.exit: close of the bar ending entry + 240 min
execution.unavailable: no eligible bar within 2 h: ungradable

costs.funding: settled Binance funding over the holding window, signed by side
costs.inference: every attempt's cost recorded in USD and reported beside net value
costs.basis: assumptions stated here; taker tier not observed

inference.model_pinning: a pinned model version where the provider offers one; an alias is recorded as an alias and every observed version string is kept

arm_definitions.statistical: lab/directional.fit_logistic on panel features, training cutoff before effective_utc, artifact hash frozen at registration
arm_definitions.frontier: a model call on the same permitted inputs through a pinned interface; NOT commissioned (no model account or host is configured in this repository)
arm_definitions.text-event: gated: no point-in-time text/event capture exists

evaluation.primary: paired difference in mean Brier score, statistical minus baseline, on the full opportunity denominator (missing forecasts counted per arm; the intersection reported beside it)
secondary: frontier arms when commissioned, as challengers
evaluation.dependence: overlapping 4h horizons on hourly decisions: 4-hour blocks; lab/calibration.block_bootstrap_ci with >= 20 blocks
evaluation.promotion: a challenger replaces nothing until it beats the incumbent at a checkpoint on the paired comparison; it inherits no evidence
evaluation.retirement: adjusted interval wholly unfavourable at a checkpoint, or operator stop

monitoring.operational_pause: inputs-unavailable or missed share > 20% over 24 h pauses the stream (an operational state, not a performance change)
monitoring.updates: a new model, prompt, tool policy or retrained artifact is a challenger arm with its own clock
